question: In which of the following cities was the 2nd edition of Khelo India Para Games 2025 held in March 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **2nd edition of Khelo India Para Games 2025** was held in **New Delhi** in March 2025. • This event is a part of the **Khelo India initiative**, launched by the Government of India to promote sports and fitness across the country. • The **Khelo India Para Games** specifically focuses on providing a platform for **para-athletes** to showcase their talent and enhance inclusivity in sports. • The event witnessed participation from para-athletes representing various states and Union Territories, promoting competitive spirit and camaraderie among differently-abled athletes. • The choice of **New Delhi** as the host city underscores its **infrastructure, accessibility, and facilities** suitable for hosting a large-scale event like the Para Games.
